meta.name: exec-cockpit
meta.description: Template skill for a leadership-transition / executive cockpit — when someone steps into or covers a leadership role and needs to not drop anything. Produces a handoff doc + decision-rights map, an "open loops" tracker, a team-comms cadence, and a recurring report/update drafter. Trigger on "/exec-cockpit", "handoff doc", "decision-rights map", "open loops tracker", "cover for <role>", "interim <role>". Customize the placeholders to your situation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成领导交接文档与决策地图，跟踪待办事项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手领导角色，需要快速梳理职责与待办
copy.tagline_en: Generate handoff docs, decision-rights maps, and open loops tracker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're stepping into a leadership role and need to organize handoffs and priorities

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你生成领导交接文档、决策权地图、待办事项追踪、团队沟通节奏和定期报告草稿。
howto.when: 当你提到“/exec-cockpit”、“交接文档”、“决策权地图”、“待办追踪”等关键词，或要求为某个角色代班时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份领导交接文档和决策权地图。
say.note: Claude 会输出 HTML 格式的文档。

say.text: 创建一份待办事项追踪表，列出所有关键关系。
say.note: Claude 会生成待办列表，每周刷新。

say.text: 起草一份给董事会的定期更新报告。
say.note: Claude 会拉取最新数据，生成草稿，不会自动发送。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you generate a leadership handoff document, decision-rights map, open loops tracker, team-comms cadence, and recurring report drafts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "/exec-cockpit", "handoff doc", "decision-rights map", "open loops tracker", "cover for <role>", or "interim <role>".

say_en.text: Generate a handoff doc and decision-rights map.
Create an open loops tracker listing all key relationships.
say_en.note: Claude generates a tracker refreshed weekly.

say_en.text: Draft a recurring update for the board.
say_en.note: Claude pulls live numbers and drafts, never auto-sends.
